coverage.r1: No echo-candidates file for 11-02. 04:06-04:23 Latin 'Intira raha ... tinnis be mayi' (inti ra7 tinbasti ma3i; Amal 04:54 'I heard my'). 18:47-19:24 garbled ('قدرة مختلف', 'وسط الـ براتولي', 'ما أجنب', 'Adatens'). 40:45/42:26 'أو' probably his 'u' (and) - not filed as C5. 43:24 'بزن النوراح' garbled. 44:12 Amal 'sharp is' likely engine for 'حرب هي'. 37:37 Amal 'بدي تحط بطلب' wrote بطلب for the verb. 28:03 أغلب الـ came before her 'Il' but Medi said she corrected him, filed. Long English stretches 28:31-29:51, 33:00-36:55, 56:00-1:01:39. Names: كانو = Kano not present as a word in this transcript (كانو at 42:33 is kaanu 'they were').
coverage.r2: Many stretches are Latin-transliterated Medi Arabic (04:06-04:28, 06:14-08:04, 09:54-11:57, 25:15-26:47) and several lines are engine-garbled (tinnis be mayi, بأسب = batdaya2, daia et = daya2et, أسر مارا الجاي, النوراح, مواسف/ياسر, حندارة). No echo-candidates file existed for this date. Name check: كانوا in this lesson is the verb 'were', not Kano. Left out on purpose: 'last kind' vs 'last one' (17:52-18:21, Amal says both fine); 40:00 قرأت (Amal repeated it, he said it right); تانية vs تانين (46:48-47:39, Amal says تانية is valid); 'costume' (not on her sheet, so not tier 3); 49:15-49:51 إشي المفضل عندي (Amal said صح). 30:20 and 44:17 may be his own self-fixes (low confidence). Several fixes are Amal's English prompts (13:44, 24:15, 30:22, 42:31).

r3_note: Latin-letter stretch 06:00-11:55 (his lines in Arabizi). The 24:10 turn holds three separate pieces: wrong verb بأسب=ba3asseb (D10), preposition منهم/لهم (D11), past tense (A11). 12:15 kaan prompt ('Where؟' = 'Were?') added as its own B6 row; D8 is the adjective-gender row and D20 its duplicate. No agreed row challenged.

rows.medi_said: كل عيلتها، آآ، طلبوني.

rows.medi_said: طلبوا مني، آآ، إنه جبت kebab.
